question: What primary disciplines combine to form nursing informatics?

options.B: Nursing science, computer science, and information science

explanation: Nursing informatics integrates nursing knowledge with computer and information sciences to manage health data effectively. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h1)

question: Why is switching from paper records to digital platforms a big win in healthcare?

options.A: It removes all responsibilities of data security from the nursing staff
options.B: It completely eliminates the need for nurses to write patient notes
options.C: It reduces documentation errors and improves patient outcomes
options.D: It ensures that patients never experience delayed medication administration

explanation: Digital systems are super helpful because they clear up messy handwriting and lost papers, making sure patient details are accurate and safe! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h1)

question: What is the main thing nurses use Microsoft Word for?

options.A: Performing complex statistical analysis on patient vital signs
options.B: Storing encrypted electronic health records securely on a server
options.C: Designing visual slide shows for community health education
options.D: Creating professional documents, reports, and care plans

explanation: Microsoft Word is your go-to tool for typing, formatting, and putting together neat reports and care plans. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h2)

question: How do document templates make writing shift handover reports easier?

options.A: They encrypt the file so it cannot be read on another computer
options.B: They prevent unauthorized staff members from viewing confidential notes
options.C: They save time by providing a pre-formatted structure for recurring data
options.D: They automatically calculate patient fluid balance and drug dosages

explanation: Templates give you a ready-made layout so you can write reports faster without forgetting important patient details. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h2)

question: What do you call a single little box where you type data in an Excel spreadsheet?
explanation: A cell is just the little box where a row and a column meet—that's where all your numbers and text go! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h3)

question: A nurse manager wants to find the average length of stay for patients on the ward. Which Excel feature should she use?
explanation: Excel functions like AVERAGE do the math for you in seconds, saving you from calculating long lists of numbers by hand. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h3)

question: What is the main purpose of using Microsoft PowerPoint in nursing?

options.A: Designing visual slide presentations for education and briefings
options.B: Entering daily nursing notes into the patient electronic chart
options.C: Sending secure encrypted messages to doctors across the hospital
options.D: Managing financial budgets and calculating staff shift rosters

explanation: PowerPoint helps you put together engaging slides to share health info clearly during lectures, workshops, or community talks. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h4)

question: Why should you keep the text on a presentation slide short and simple?

options.A: To prevent the audience from being overwhelmed while the nurse speaks
options.B: To comply with strict government rules on medical documentation
options.C: To automatically generate an accurate summary report for the hospital board
options.D: To ensure the presentation file size remains small enough to email

explanation: Slides are meant to highlight your main points, not turn into a textbook page that people have to stare at and read! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h4)

question: Which of these is a serious breach of patient data security on the ward?

options.A: Closing a presentation window after finishing a community health talk
options.B: Leaving a patient's electronic health record open on an unattended computer
options.C: Creating a backup file of ward inventory statistics in Excel
options.D: Using Microsoft Word to type a clinical shift handover report

explanation: Never leave patient screens unlocked and unattended! It puts private medical info at risk for anyone walking by. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h5)

question: Why must nurses always log out of clinical software before stepping away from a computer?

options.A: To protect patient privacy and confidentiality from unauthorized access
options.B: To prevent the computer hardware from overheating and shutting down
options.C: To save battery power on mobile workstations used during ward rounds
options.D: To ensure the software updates automatically without interruption

explanation: Logging out keeps patient data safe and ensures no one else can view or change records using your account. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h5)
